"Who has the highest average finishing rate between the highest and shortest football player?" → Compare average finishing of tallest vs shortest player; the answer is the name of the one with higher average.

Note: heights — max height and min height in Player table.

Let me query.

Average finishing: AVG(finishing) over all Player_Attributes records for that player.

Let me first check the tallest/shortest and their avg finishing.

SQL:

WITH tall AS (SELECT p.player_api_id, p.player_name, p.height, AVG(pa.finishing) AS avg_fin FROM Player p JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE p.height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player) GROUP BY p.player_api_id)

Careful: multiple players may share max height. Let's check.

Let me do an exploratory query first.
Now let me explore the data — tallest and shortest players and their finishing averages.

input.sql:
SELECT p.player_api_id, p.player_name, p.height, AVG(pa.finishing) AS avg_fin, COUNT(pa.finishing) AS n
FROM Player p JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.height IN ((SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player), (SELECT MIN(height) FROM Player))
GROUP BY p.player_api_id, p.player_name, p.height
ORDER BY p.height DESC
